name: Bonnibel Valentine
source:
A charming and genteel woman who loves to bake and delights in the joy of others. A source of infinite homespun wisdom, she values honesty and politeness, but isn't afraid of a little "colorful" flirting now and again.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/sadpandastudios/hush-hush-only-your-love-can-save-them/description]Kickstarter[/url]]
